title: Prompt Templates
summary: This module provides various prompt template classes for constructing and managing prompts for language models, including string-based, chat-based, and few-shot templates.

nodes.label: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.title: Base Prompt Template
nodes.description: The foundational class for all prompt templates, defining common interfaces for input variables, partial variables, and formatting methods.

nodes.label: StringPromptTemplate
nodes.title: String Prompt Template
nodes.description: An abstract base class for prompt templates that produce a single string output, extending BasePromptTemplate.

nodes.label: ChatMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.title: Chat Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A template for individual chat messages, allowing specification of role and content, used within chat-based prompt structures.

nodes.label: AIMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.title: AI Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A specialized chat message template for messages originating from the AI, inheriting from a string-image message template.

nodes.label: SystemMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.title: System Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A specialized chat message template for system-level messages, not typically shown to the user.

nodes.label: FewShotChatMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.title: Few-Shot Chat Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A chat prompt template that incorporates few-shot examples, either fixed or dynamically selected, to guide the language model.

nodes.label: FewShotPromptWithTemplates
nodes.title: Few-Shot Prompt with Templates
nodes.description: A prompt template that includes few-shot examples, using separate prompt templates for examples, prefixes, and suffixes.

nodes.label: StructuredPrompt
nodes.title: Structured Prompt
nodes.description: A chat prompt template designed for generating structured outputs, requiring a schema to define the expected output format.

nodes.label: ChatPromptValueConcrete
nodes.title: Chat Prompt Value Concrete
nodes.description: A concrete representation of a chat prompt value, explicitly listing the types of messages it accepts for external schemas.

nodes.label: Load Few-Shot Prompt
nodes.title: Load Few-Shot Prompt
nodes.description: Utility function to load a few-shot prompt template from a configuration dictionary, handling example and sub-template loading.

nodes.label: Load Prompt
nodes.title: Load Prompt
nodes.description: Utility function to load a generic prompt template from a configuration dictionary, supporting various template formats.

nodes.label: Jinja2 Formatter
nodes.title: Jinja2 Template Formatter
nodes.description: Formats a template string using the Jinja2 templating engine, with security considerations for untrusted inputs.

nodes.label: Mustache Formatter
nodes.title: Mustache Template Formatter
nodes.description: Formats a template string using the Mustache templating engine.

nodes.label: BaseMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.title: Base Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: An abstract base class for prompt templates that produce a list of chat messages.

groups.label: Base Templates
groups.title: Base Prompt Templates
groups.description: Core abstract classes for defining prompt structures and their fundamental behaviors.

groups.label: String-based Templates
groups.title: String-based Prompt Templates
groups.description: Templates that generate a single string output, often used for simpler prompts or as components of larger templates.

groups.label: Chat-based Templates
groups.title: Chat-based Prompt Templates
groups.description: Templates designed for conversational AI, handling individual messages and sequences of messages with roles.

groups.label: Template Utilities
groups.title: Prompt Template Utilities
groups.description: Functions and components for loading and formatting prompt templates.

groups.label: Prompt Values
groups.title: Prompt Value Representations
groups.description: Classes representing the concrete output values of prompt templates.
